sense: the Greek weight and sum of money

terms.gloss: a talent: a Greek weight, and a sum of money (the Attic talent held sixty minae)
evidence: Cic. Tusc. 5.91: cum lēgātī ab Alexandrō quīnquāgintā eī talenta attulissent (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: cum lēgātī ab Alexandrō quīnquāgintā eī talenta attulissent
phrases.english: when envoys from Alexander had brought him fifty talents
